Question ID: ENG4_U06_L05_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG4.C.02

Presentation review: A telehealth presentation includes source citations and a wait-time chart, but it also has dense slide paragraphs, undefined technical terms, low color contrast, and an unlabeled chart for a mixed audience. Which option is the strongest evaluation or revision?

answer.text: A. Judge the presentation only by whether the colors look attractive.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Color is only one design feature. A strong evaluation also checks clarity, credibility, accessibility, evidence, and audience fit.

answer.text: B. Define technical terms and reduce dense paragraphs so a mixed audience can follow the message.

feedback.text: Correct. This answer best applies the lesson skill with clear reasoning, evidence, and audience awareness.

answer.text: C. Keep technical terms undefined because advanced vocabulary always improves credibility.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Undefined technical language can confuse a mixed audience. Academic vocabulary should be precise and explained when the audience needs support.

answer.text: D. Remove source citations because they distract from slide design.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Removing citations weakens credibility. Source credits can be formatted cleanly while still showing responsible evidence use.
